source.note: ast.md Nodes: the written text of a StateIgnoredText leaves out a diagram comment that a comment region cuts (common.md Comment lines) whole, the whitespace inside it included, and keeps the line feed that ends it; here the line after the comment region is `  [*]`, whose spaces are inside the comment too, so the textBeforeBody of X is `""`, a space, a line feed, two spaces, and `accDescr {}`, and mermaid.js has no start state.
